name: web
description: The mod protocol front door — Rust (axum) catalog API + Next.js app. A live, searchable explorer of every module (orbit + core): browse the catalog, read each module's source tree, and open its running app, served under modc2.com/web.

/mods.docs: Live catalog of every orbit module

/mods/:name/tree.docs: Recursive source tree for a module (build output elided)

/mods/:name/file.docs: Read one source file, sandboxed to the module dir (?path=)

/registry.docs: On-chain Registry view via the chain module (which modules are registered)

/graph.docs: Module dependency graph (nodes + edges from each module's deps)
